title: DataArgs
summary: Every loader and action receives the Request, decoded params, and an AbortSignal.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Every loader and action receives the Request, decoded params, and an AbortSignal. Use request.url for query parameters and request.formData() for mutations. Forward signal to cancellable work.

sections.title: Handler reason
sections.body: The router supplies reason: initial, navigation, revalidation, fetcher or action. Use it to choose paginated navigation reads versus refresh behavior; browser history may already reflect the destination when a loader runs. Direct HTTP dispatch may omit this optional field.
